messages:
maya: heads up — noticed a weird p95 jump on /generate for tenant 'foo' after fallback weight shift. p50 looks fine. sample_count for the window is tiny (12). feels like a sparse-cohort quantile artifact.
cheng: can you paste the query + counts? also do we know origin breakdown (gateway vs dedicated)?
maya: ran a quick query: ```SELECT percentile(lat_ms, 95) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/generate' AND tenant='foo' AND ts >= 1680000000 AND ts <= 1680000600;``` count=12. histogram bins we get back: [20,40,60,80,200,900]. p95 shows 900ms which is literally the max bin — seems interpolation/t-digest over small sample is misleading.
dom: yeah this is classic small-sample noise. We should surface sample_count and the histogram on the percentile card. Right now the card only plots the line (no context). for tiny cohorts it should show 'unstable' or similar.
sara: :thumbsup: backend currently merges with tdigest compression=100 which is fine for big cohorts but bad for <~100 samples. fallback idea: if count < 100 use exact quantile (or return raw_points) so UI can render a dot overlay.
leo: we already have merge_mode on rollups. Could add a query-time override: 'force_exact_if_small'. UI could toggle it. low risk and good UX.
maya: concrete proposal: 1) degrouper: when sample_count < N (suggest 100) query the raw points and compute exact quantile; 2) UI: show sample_count + raw_points overlay + a small badge: 'n < 100 — p95 unstable'; 3) annotate with sample_origin breakdown and active routing weight at the time.
cheng: I can prototype the probe: add sample_count line and show a red badge when n < 50 for starters. who owns the percentile card component?
dom: frontend: sara. backend: me. cheng + maya can spec the degrouper behavior and thresholds. I'll open a tracking issue.
ops-bot: deploy:stat-agg-service v1.12.3 rolled to prod — commit 4c3a9
sara: I'll take the frontend changes (badge + overlay). dom — can you expose raw_points for small cohorts in the rollup API and add a flag? please add a feature gate. link the spec to the board.
maya: creating issue now: https://redwood/issue/PLAT-1234 — includes repro queries, suggested thresholds (50/100), and UX mocks. tagging eng-platform.
cheng: quick follow: does this intersect with routing quotas? when fallback weights shift the origin composition can change and that also affects pctl. we should annotate 'mixed-origin' if >1 origin in the sample.
leo: +1. annotate with origin breakdown and primary route weight snapshot. maybe a small pill 'mixed-origin' or 'gateway-only'.
dom: sounds good. i'll add origin breakdown and a 'degrouper' flag to the API contract in the tracker. can we do a short sync tomorrow (20min) to align?
sara: ack — will sketch mocks and upload to the issue.
maya: thanks all. quick wins: show sample_count on the percentile card and add an 'unstable' badge for tiny cohorts. we'll iterate on degrouper and origin annotation after the sync.
